purpose: Preregister future evidence cases for a Protected Control Plane kill-switch successor. This plan does not implement, operate, certify, or authorize a runtime control.

authority_boundary.implementation_precondition: accepted ADR-018-conformant successor plus independent security/safety review and qualified recovery ownership
authority_boundary.stage_boundary: NB-5 controlled sandbox and later; NB-1 remains effect-free

common_oracles.state_oracle: Durable authoritative state has the expected state and monotonic revision, or defaults to disabled on unknown, unavailable, stale, conflicting, or scope-mismatched state.
common_oracles.audit_oracle: Every attempted transition or denial has an append-only, causally linked audit record; missing audit persistence prevents admission or transition completion.
common_oracles.claim_oracle: No budget, resource, fence, credential, or action claim is released, reused, or retried while an effect is ambiguous; authoritative reconciliation is required.

case_schema.lineage_rule: Every case binds the complete authenticated Brain->Tenant->Area->Project->Session lineage; an unknown or mismatched ancestor fails closed.

result_schema.binding_rule: Each reference identifies immutable versioned evidence for the executed case. Missing, mutable, unverifiable, or lineage-mismatched references invalidate the result and fail the case closed.

acceptance_requirements: All cases execute against an accepted successor implementation only.

Each result contains immutable lineage plus contract_artifact_ref, implementation_artifact_ref, environment_artifact_ref, fault_injection_artifact_ref, and ledger_artifact_ref, with independently reviewable audit/claim oracles.
A pass in one case cannot compensate for a missing, unknown, or failed safety case.
No case result authorizes production, recognition, or runtime release without separately accepted gates.
